import os,sys,json,subprocess,hashlib,time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
from git_identity import verify_go_binary
root=Path.cwd(); temp=root.parent/'temp'; evidence=root.parent/'evidence'; source=temp/'source'
sha=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=source,text=True).strip()
go=temp/'gopath/pkg/mod/golang.org/toolchain@v0.0.1-go1.26.8.darwin-arm64/bin/go'
record={'source_commit':sha,'qualified_run':37994377940,'measurements':[],'binaries':{}}
for name in ('ownedprepared','mariamem-host'):
 p=temp/name;info=verify_go_binary(source,p,sha,go=go)
 record['binaries'][name]={'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'buildinfo':info}
record['platform']='local macOS27 arm64, informational; not native minimum-platform qualification'
def save(): (evidence/'campaign.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
def run(name,cmd,env):
 item={'name':name,'argv':cmd,'trace_directory':env.get('MARIAMEM_TIMING_DIR'),'started':time.time()};record['measurements'].append(item);save()
 p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=source,env=env);item.update(exit_code=p.returncode,seconds=time.time()-item['started']);save();p.check_returncode();print(name,'completed',round(item['seconds'],2),flush=True)
env=dict(os.environ,GOMAXPROCS='2',TMPDIR=str(temp));env.pop('MARIAMEM_TIMING_DIR',None)
for payload in (0,10,100):
 for trial in range(3):
  name=f'go-{payload}-{trial}';run(name,[str(temp/'ownedprepared'),'-payload-mib',str(payload),'-forks','16','-helper',str(temp/'process_cost'),'-label',sha,'-out',str(evidence/(name+'.json'))],env)
 trace=temp/f'trace-{payload}';trace.mkdir();name=f'trace-{payload}'
 run(name,[str(temp/'ownedprepared'),'-payload-mib',str(payload),'-forks','2','-label',sha,'-out',str(evidence/(name+'.json'))],dict(env,MARIAMEM_TIMING_DIR=str(trace)))
 name=f'provision-{payload}';artifact=temp/f'artifact-{payload}'
 run(name,[str(temp/'ownedprepared'),'-payload-mib',str(payload),'-forks','1','-export',str(artifact),'-label',sha,'-out',str(evidence/(name+'.json'))],env)
 penv=dict(env,PYTHONPATH=str(source/'python'))
 for trial in range(3):
  name=f'python-import-{payload}-{trial}'
  run(name,[str(temp/'venv/bin/python'),str(source/'benchmarks/ownedprepared/import_measure.py'),'--artifact',str(artifact),'--host',str(temp/'mariamem-host'),'--label','candidate','--out',str(evidence/(name+'.json')),'--forks','16','--helper',str(temp/'process_cost')],penv)
 name=f'python-capture-{payload}'
 run(name,[str(temp/'venv/bin/python'),str(source/'benchmarks/ownedprepared/import_measure.py'),'--artifact',str(artifact),'--host',str(temp/'mariamem-host'),'--label','candidate','--out',str(evidence/(name+'.json')),'--capture','--capture-destination',str(temp/f'capture-{payload}'),'--helper',str(temp/'process_cost')],penv)
record['completed']=True;save()

import os,sys,json,time,resource,subprocess,hashlib,functools,contextlib
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
temp=Path(__file__).resolve().parent; root=temp.parent/'worktree'; evidence=temp.parent/'evidence'; source=temp/'source'
sys.path[:0]=[str(source/'benchmarks'),str(source/'python')]
import _common as common
import mariamem,pymysql,docker
from testcontainers.core.container import Reaper
client=docker.from_env()
image=client.images.get('mariadb:12.3')
args=SimpleNamespace(resolved_image=image.id,rows=1000)
# Exact host identity was authenticated before the source checkout advanced;
# only benchmark/main.go and its README differ, never SDK/host/runtime inputs.
campaign=json.loads((evidence/'campaign.json').read_text())
host=temp/'mariamem-host'
assert hashlib.sha256(host.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==campaign['binaries']['mariamem-host']['sha256']
mariamem.start=functools.partial(mariamem.start,host_binary=host)
before={c.id for c in client.containers.list()}
Reaper.get_instance() # infrastructure startup excluded, database startup included
allowed={c.id for c in client.containers.list()}
report={'runtime_source':campaign['source_commit'],'host_sha256':campaign['binaries']['mariamem-host']['sha256'],'image_id':image.id,'image_digests':image.attrs.get('RepoDigests',[]),'docker':{k:client.info().get(k) for k in ('ServerVersion','OperatingSystem','Architecture','NCPU','MemTotal')},'background_container_count':len(before),'boundary':'4 tests, 1000 rows x32 bytes; setup + independent application commit/rollback + disposal/reset; Docker VM CPU is not host child CPU','samples':[],'completed':False}
def save():(evidence/'product-control.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
def workload(db):
 with pymysql.connect(**db.info) as app, app.cursor() as cur:
  cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM benchmark_rows');assert cur.fetchone()==(1000,)
  cur.execute('SELECT payload FROM benchmark_rows WHERE id=0');assert cur.fetchone()==('x'*32,)
  cur.execute('UPDATE benchmark_rows SET payload=%s WHERE id=0',('changed',));app.commit()
 with pymysql.connect(**db.info) as observer,observer.cursor() as cur:
  cur.execute('SELECT payload FROM benchmark_rows WHERE id=0');assert cur.fetchone()==('changed',)
  cur.execute('DELETE FROM benchmark_rows WHERE id=1');observer.rollback()
  cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM benchmark_rows');assert cur.fetchone()==(1000,)
def reset(db):
 with pymysql.connect(**db.info) as conn,conn.cursor() as cur:
  cur.execute('TRUNCATE TABLE benchmark_rows')
  cur.executemany('INSERT INTO benchmark_rows VALUES(%s,%s)',[(i,'x'*32) for i in range(1000)])
  conn.commit()
def counters(db,backend):
 if backend=='mariamem':
  pid=db.database.diagnostics['host_pid']
  return json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(temp/'process_cost'),str(pid)],text=True))[str(pid)]
 return None
try:
 for trial in range(3):
  modes=['mariamem-fresh','mariamem-fork','container-fresh','container-reset']
  if trial%2:modes.reverse()
  for mode in modes:
   phases=[];cpu0=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN);begun=time.perf_counter()
   with contextlib.ExitStack() as suite:
    saved=None;shared=None;backend='mariamem' if mode.startswith('mariamem') else 'testcontainers'
    if mode=='mariamem-fork':
     prep= suite.enter_context(common.instance(backend,args));common.probe(prep,rows=1000,seed=True)
     prep.database.wait_disconnected();saved=suite.enter_context(prep.database.snapshot())
    elif mode=='container-reset':
     shared=suite.enter_context(common.instance(backend,args,label='v045-p2-control'));common.probe(shared,rows=1000,seed=True)
    preparation=time.perf_counter()-begun
    for i in range(4):
     step=time.perf_counter()
     with contextlib.ExitStack() as test:
      db=shared or test.enter_context(common.instance(backend,args,saved,label='v045-p2-control'))
      ready,version=common.probe(db,rows=1000,seed=saved is None and shared is None)
      work=time.perf_counter();workload(db);cleanup=time.perf_counter()
      if shared:reset(shared)
      sample=counters(db,backend)
     phases.append({'setup_ready_seconds':ready-step,'sql_seconds':cleanup-work,'cleanup_seconds':time.perf_counter()-cleanup,'resource_before_close':sample})
   elapsed=time.perf_counter()-begun;cpu1=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
   remaining={c.id for c in client.containers.list()}-allowed
   assert not remaining,remaining
   report['samples'].append({'mode':mode,'trial':trial,'suite_seconds':elapsed,'preparation_seconds':preparation,'server_version':version,'child_process_cpu_seconds':cpu1.ru_utime+cpu1.ru_stime-cpu0.ru_utime-cpu0.ru_stime,'tests':phases,'unexpected_running_containers':sorted(remaining)})
   save();print(mode,trial,round(elapsed,3),flush=True)
 report['completed']=True
finally:
 save();client.close()

import sys,json,hashlib,functools,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
temp=Path(__file__).resolve().parent; source=temp/'source'; evidence=temp.parent/'evidence'
sys.path[:0]=[str(source/'benchmarks'),str(source/'python')]
import _common as common
import mariamem,docker
from testcontainers.core.container import Reaper
host=temp/'mariamem-host';campaign=json.loads((evidence/'campaign.json').read_text())
assert hashlib.sha256(host.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==campaign['binaries']['mariamem-host']['sha256']
mariamem.start=functools.partial(mariamem.start,host_binary=host)
client=docker.from_env();image=client.images.get('mariadb:12.3');Reaper.get_instance()
args=SimpleNamespace(resolved_image=image.id,rows=1000)
report={'runtime_source':campaign['source_commit'],'image_id':image.id,'scope':'one ready seeded database per backend, outside suite timers; not peak or equal accounting; Linux cgroup memory excludes full Docker VM','samples':[]}
try:
 for backend in ('mariamem','testcontainers'):
  with common.instance(backend,args,label='v045-resource-control') as db:
   _,version=common.probe(db,rows=1000,seed=True)
   if backend=='mariamem':
    pid=db.database.diagnostics['host_pid'];value=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(temp/'process_cost'),str(pid)],text=True))[str(pid)]
   else:
    containers=client.containers.list(filters={'label':'mariamem.benchmark=v045-resource-control'});assert len(containers)==1
    stats=containers[0].stats(stream=False)
    value={k:stats[k] for k in ('cpu_stats','precpu_stats','memory_stats')}
   report['samples'].append({'backend':backend,'version':version,'ready_resource':value})
 assert not client.containers.list(filters={'label':'mariamem.benchmark=v045-resource-control'})
 report['completed']=True
finally:
 (evidence/'product-resources.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');client.close()
